text.p: Paul Comiti, known to millions as "the gorilla" when serving as Charles de Gaulle's personal bodyguard throughout his 1958-1969 presidency, has died aged 75, his family said on Friday.

News photographs always showed the burly Comiti only centimetres (inches) from de Gaulle, especially during the early 1960s when the late leader was target of repeated plots to kill him by the extreme rightist Secret Army Organisation (OAS) which sought to keep Algeria French.
Comiti joined De Gaulle in 1941 as a young volunteer in the Free French forces in Britain and served through Worlfd War Two on corvettes escorting convoys across the north Atlantic.
